what: Watermark PDF writes a see-through word or short phrase, such as CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or COPY, across every page of a PDF. You choose the text, whether it runs diagonally or straight, how strong it looks and its color.

It helps you mark drafts so nobody mistakes them for final versions, label copies you send to a client, or show that a document is private. The text is sized automatically to fit each page, so you do not have to measure anything.
The watermark is added inside your browser. Your PDF is not uploaded.
uses: Stamp DRAFT on a document that is still being reviewed.
Add CONFIDENTIAL before sharing salary, legal or medical papers.
Write something like COPY FOR BANK on ID documents you send, so the copy cannot easily be reused for another purpose.
Put your name or company name on samples, portfolios or quotes.
Write SAMPLE across pages you share before a sale.
tutorial: Click "Click or drop a PDF here" or drag a PDF onto the box. The tool shows the file name and page count.
The box starts with CONFIDENTIAL. Replace it with your own text, up to 60 characters. The tool writes it in bold Helvetica, exactly as you type it, so use capitals if you want capitals.
"Diagonal across the page" runs the text from the bottom-left corner toward the top-right corner. "Straight across the middle" writes it horizontally through the center.
This sets how see-through the text is. "Light" is about 12% visible, "Medium" about 22% and is the default, and "Strong" about 40%.
Pick "Gray", "Red" or "Blue". Gray is the most neutral. Red draws the most attention.
A message such as "Watermarked 8 pages" appears. Click "Download PDF" to save the file, named like contract-watermark.pdf.
features: Any word or short phrase up to 60 characters.
Diagonal across the page or straight across the middle.
The text is sized to about 70% of the page diagonal (or width), and never taller than a quarter of the page, then centered.
Light, Medium or Strong see-through levels.
All pages are marked in one click, and pages of different sizes each get a watermark that fits.

example.title: Worked example: a draft contract
example.text: Peter has contract.pdf with 8 A4 pages and wants to send it for review. He types DRAFT - NOT FOR SIGNING, keeps "Diagonal across the page", picks "Light" and "Red". He clicks "Add watermark" and sees "Watermarked 8 pages". In contract-watermark.pdf, the red text runs corner to corner on every page, faint enough that the contract stays easy to read.

tips: Short words like DRAFT look bigger and bolder because the tool fits the text to the page. Long phrases come out smaller.
Use "Light" for documents people must read carefully, and "Strong" for samples you want to protect more.
Keep a copy of the original file without a watermark. The watermark cannot be removed with this tool.
Running the tool twice adds a second watermark on top of the first. Start again from the original if you want to change it.
A watermark discourages copying but does not lock the file. For real protection, share only what is needed.
problems: The message says "Type the watermark text"
The text box is empty or only has spaces. Type a word and try again.
The watermark is hard to see
Choose "Strong" or a stronger color such as red, and add the watermark again to the original file.
The watermark covers the content too much
Choose "Light" and use gray, then run it again on the original file.
Text in Arabic, Chinese or emoji cannot be selected in the result
Letters outside the standard PDF font are added as a picture of the text. It looks the same and is see-through, but it cannot be copied as text.
